mapper.select: SELECT eb.eb_id, eb.stu_id, eb.hq_id, eb.c_id, eb.wrong_answer, eb.correct_answer, eb.analysis, eb.tag, eb.error_count, eb.is_mastered, eb.last_wrong_time, eb.create_time, eb.update_time, c.c_name, c.type FROM my_error_book eb LEFT JOIN my_course c ON eb.c_id = c.c_id WHERE eb.stu_id = #{stuId} ORDER BY eb.last_wrong_time DESC

SELECT eb.eb_id, eb.stu_id, eb.hq_id, eb.c_id, eb.wrong_answer, eb.correct_answer, eb.analysis, eb.tag, eb.error_count, eb.is_mastered, eb.last_wrong_time, eb.create_time, eb.update_time, c.c_name, c.type FROM my_error_book eb LEFT JOIN my_course c ON eb.c_id = c.c_id WHERE eb.stu_id = #{stuId} AND c.type = #{courseType} ORDER BY eb.last_wrong_time DESC
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM my_error_book WHERE stu_id = #{stuId} AND is_mastered = 0
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM my_error_book WHERE stu_id = #{stuId} AND is_mastered = 1
